text_block_list.text:
A few days after winning the Arima Kinen 
and visiting sensei to give my milestone 
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I came on an empty stomach just like you 
said, but... What's the occasion? Why are 
you all dressed up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"‘Well then, someday, make sure you treat 
me to your ramen, too.’ ...Those were the 
words Master said to us two years ago."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Ultimate Ramen' we've finally 
reached. ...Please, give it a taste!"

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"The Ultimate Ramen"... Big words. Don't 
expect any flattery in my review, alright?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: —Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Color me impressed. This is 
restaurant-quality! ...Hm? What's this 
seaweed rice cracker on the side for?
choice_data_list:
It's a topping! You can add it before or 
after!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... Is that so? ...Even so, this 
simple flavor, this rice crackerâ

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That brings back memories... 
Remember that? When you got chewed out by 
me at the shopping district shop?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You two used to be spinning your wheels 
back then, and now you've conquered a 
Grand Prix race... You've really grown 
big.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sensei...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I made this ramen with the 
exact memory of that day in mind."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Those rice crackers are the ones we 
prepared for you that day, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And for the soup, I recreated the flavor 
of the ramen from that shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Reminding everyone of 'who we were that 
day', and letting them taste how much 
we've evolved since... That is the secret 
ingredient in this ramen!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Meeting Sensei when I was little is how 
I found my dream.
choice_data_list: I was taught how to make dreams come true.

Someone taught me how to make my dreams 
come true.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"And meeting Sensei is what led to me 
meeting you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Meeting that teacher was what guided us 
onto this path.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You are the best teacher in the whole 
world! ――To us, for the rest of our lives!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't talk nonsense. It was all thanks 
to your own strength."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp! Sluuuuurp!* ...*Gulp*. Ahh, so 
good... It's just the absolute best...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Right here is fine. Thanks for the treat 
today. You fed me good stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No! Likewise. Even this isn't enough to 
show my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really are dutiful to a fault. 
...But isn't there one more person? 
Someone else you ought to say thanks to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No need to worry. ...To be honest, 
I'm fully prepared!

While taking a break after finishing the 
cleanup, Narita Top Road returned from 
seeing everyone off.
choice_data_list: Welcome back. Thanks for seeing me off.
Welcome back. Thanks for seeing me off!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No! The pleasure is mine, leaving the 
cleanup to you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...So, um, Trainer! This is out of 
nowhere, but there's something I want to 
give you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With all my gratitude for the past three 
years! Please accept this handmade ramen 
bowl!

Dazed, I take the box and open it. Inside 
rested a beautiful black ceramic bowl.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how delicious the ramen is, 
you can't serve it to anyone without a 
bowl.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: To me, Trainer was truly a vessel.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It was only because you served as that 
vessel that I was able to fulfill 
everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was able to deliver Narita Top Road's 
feelings to so many people.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. For carrying me into 
everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so very much!

A hot tear welled up and dripped into the 
bowl. Wiping it away, I looked at the bowl 
once more.
choice_data_list: ...Man, my junior disciple is so cool.
...Man, my junior disciple is so cool.

text_block_list.text:
I'll cherish this for the rest of my life. 
This vessel, the feelings poured into it, 
and the memories.
